description:
The chat input toolbar's file picker dialog was stuck open and wouldn't close.
Root cause: `Modal.vue` manually relocated its DOM via `$root.$el.appendChild()` in `mounted()`, which leaks when combined with `v-if`, plus a blanket `stopPropagation` desynced the dialog from the composer lifecycle.
Fix: replaced the shared `<modal>` with Vue's native `<Teleport to="body">` in `ChatInputToolbar.vue`, so `v-if` mounts/unmounts cleanly.
Added backdrop click, an ✕ close button, and `Esc` support (with `beforeUnmount` listener cleanup) for accessibility parity.
Flagged follow-ups: `FileExplorerPanel` never emits `open` (so "pick file ⇒ attach" is dead), and `file-selected` isn't consumed upstream.

messages.content: We must take more space in mobile for the modals, if not full screen at least use full width and appearing from bottom. @Mockups create 3 different mockups on how to show mobile modals

# Mobile Modal Mockups — 3 Functional Prototypes **Direct recommendation:** Adopt **Variant A (Bottom Sheet, 85%)** as the default for `Modal.vue` on mobile, with **Variant B (Full-screen)** reserved for multi-select/immersive flows. Both fix your bug at the root: the sheet lives *inside* the phone frame with full width, so taps on folders can't be mistaken for an "outside" composer click. --- ## 1. Screen / Flow Outline (shared by all 3) | # | Screen | Must actually work | |---|--------|--------------------| | 1 | **Chat screen** | Header w/ attachment count, 2 seeded messages, composer with attachment chips | | 2 | **Attachment chips** | Render from state, removable, persist across reload | | 3 | **File sheet** | Opens from composer, breadcrumb navigation, folder→folder, file→attach, loading/empty/error states | | 4 | **Sheet dismissal** | Backdrop tap, X button, `Esc`, (A & C) drag-down | | 5 | **Dev controls** | "Reset mock" clears `localStorage` + reloads | **What differs per variant** | | Height | Radius | Origin | Extra capability | |---|---|---|---|---| | **A** | 85% | `rounded-t-2xl` | bottom | drag-to-dismiss handle | | **B** | 100% | none | bottom | **multi-select + sticky confirm bar** | | **C** | 62% ⇄ 95% | `rounded-t-2xl` | bottom | **snap points + file preview when expanded** | --- ## 2. Mock API Contract | Method | Endpoint | Query / Body | Response | |---|---|---|---| | `GET` | `/api/files` | `?path=src/components` | `[{ name, type:'dir'\|'file', path, size? }]` | | `GET` | `/api/files` | `?path=restricted` | `403 { error:'permission_denied', message }` | | `GET` | `/api/files` | `?path=empty-folder` | `[]` | | `POST` | `/api/attachments` | `{ path, name, size }` | `201 { id, path, name, size }` | All calls go through one `mockFetch()` — swap it for real `fetch` and the UI is unchanged. --- # Variant A — Bottom Sheet (85%, full width) Full-bleed width, 85% height, rounded top corners, grab handle, backdrop dimming the chat behind it. ```html modal-mobile-bottomsheet.html Mockup — Mobile Modal A · Bottom Sheet 85%

**Try it**
1. Sheet opens at **62%**. Tap **src → components → chat** — stays open.
2. Tap **ChatInputToolbar.vue** → row highlights; the **Attach** button enables.
3. Tap the **grab handle** → sheet grows to **95%**, label flips to "Expanded", and the preview pane reveals the mocked file body.
4. Tap **Attach** → sheet closes, chip appears.
5. Drag the handle **down** from peek past ~90px → dismisses. Drag up → snaps to expanded.
6. **restricted** → error; **empty-folder** → empty; **Reset mock** clears everything.

---

## Comparison & Recommendation

| Criterion | A · Bottom Sheet 85% | B · Full-screen | C · Snap Sheet |
|---|---|---|---|
| Screen real estate (mobile) | ~85% | 100% | 62% ⇄ 95% |
| Feels "native" | High | Highest | High |
| Context kept visible | Yes (top 15% + dim) | No | Yes at peek |
| Multi-select friendly | Okay | **Best** | Okay |
| Preview friendly | Okay | Good | **Best** (progressive) |
| Implementation complexity | Low | Low | Medium (snap math) |
| Keeps composer mounted | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

### How this maps onto `Modal.vue`

All three use the **same structural change**: the wrapper stops being a viewport-centred `flex` box and becomes a bottom-anchored positioner, with the box itself sized in **percentages of the parent frame** rather than `vh`.

```vue src/components/Modal.vue



```

The outer container changes from `flex items-center justify-center p-4` to `flex items-end justify-center p-0 md:items-center md:p-4`, and the modal gains a `grab-handle` slot + `translate-y-full` enter/leave for mobile.

**Recommended rollout:** ship **Variant A** as the default `position="sheet"` on mobile (smallest diff, fixes the bug, keeps context) and add **Variant B** as `position="fullscreen"` opt-in for flows that genuinely need the room (multi-select attach, settings wizards).

---

## What's mocked

- **Endpoints:** `GET /api/files`, `POST /api/attachments` (Variant C adds `GET /api/preview`) — all served by an in-page `mockFetch()`, never the network.
- **Seed data:** a fake repo tree with real codx-junior paths (`src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue`, `Modal.vue`, …), plus two deterministic state paths: `restricted` → 403, `empty-folder` → `[]`.
- **Latency:** 200–480 ms on every call so loading skeletons are actually visible.
- **Auth:** no login; `DB.user` is seeded and unused.
- **Persistence:** `localStorage` under `mock.codx.mobileModal.[A|B|C]` with an in-memory fallback for `file://`.
- **Auto-open:** each sheet opens itself ~450 ms after load purely for review.

## Run note

Open `modal-mobile-bottomsheet.html`, `modal-mobile-fullscreen.html`, or `modal-mobile-snapsheet.html` directly in a browser — **no server needed**. Use device emulation (or a phone on the same LAN) to feel the real `100dvh` behaviour.

messages.content: Implement Variant A for Modal component in mobile

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** Implement **Variant A** for the generic `Modal` component on mobile: - Full-width sheet anchored to the **bottom edge** (not a centered dialog) - **85% height**, rounded **top** corners only - Slides **up from the bottom** on entry - **Grab handle** to drag down and dismiss - Backdrop tap + `Esc` + `✕` still dismiss - **Desktop (`md+`) behaviour must stay identical** to today **Strategic Approach** 1. Change the outer positioner from `items-center p-4` to `items-end p-0` on mobile, reverting to centered on `md+`. 2. Give the box mobile dimensions (`w-full h-[85%] rounded-t-2xl`) and keep the desktop rules under `md:`. 3. Swap the enter animation conditionally: `slide-in-from-bottom-full` on mobile vs `zoom-in-95` on desktop (avoiding fragile `md:slide-in-from-bottom-0` overrides). 4. Add a mobile-only grab handle plus pointer drag handlers (listeners on `window` so the gesture survives leaving the tiny handle). 5. Inline `transform` + `transition: none` while dragging so the sheet tracks the finger, then lets `transition-all` snap it back on release. **Dependencies & Risks** - `tailwindcss-animate` is already used (`animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95`), so `slide-in-from-bottom-full` is available. - `animate-in` does **not** set `animation-fill-mode`, so inline `transform` during drag is safe after the enter animation ends. - **Class conflict:** `ChatInputToolbar` currently passes `class="w-5/6 h-5/6"` (base, no breakpoint). `w-full` beats `w-5/6` by Tailwind source order, but the height conflict (`h-5/6` vs `h-[85%]`) is ambiguous. I scope those to `md:` so there is **zero** mobile ambiguity and desktop is preserved exactly. - **Detection:** use the existing `this.$ui.isMobile` when present, falling back to a `matchMedia` listener resolved in `created()` (so the correct entry animation runs on first paint). **Target Files** - `src/components/Modal.vue` — responsive rewrite + drag-to-dismiss. - `src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue` — scope the caller's sizing classes to `md:`. --- ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach - **`src/components/Modal.vue`** - Container: `items-end p-0 md:items-center md:p-4`. - Box: mobile sheet classes + `md:` dialog classes; conditional enter animation; `role="dialog"`. - Add mobile-only grab handle. - `data`: `isMobileViewport`, `dragging`, `dragStartY`, `dragOffset`. - `computed`: `isMobile`, `dragStyle`. - `created`: matchMedia. `mounted`/`beforeUnmount`: pointer listeners. `methods`: drag handlers. - Body: add `min-h-0 overscroll-contain`. - **`src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue`** - Modal usage: `class="w-5/6 h-5/6"` → `class="md:w-5/6 md:h-5/6"` (single line + comment tweak). --- ## 3. File Changes ```vue src/components/Modal.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | root container | `flex items-center justify-center p-4` → `flex items-end justify-center p-0 md:items-center md:p-4` (bottom anchor on mobile). | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | modal box | Added mobile sheet sizing (`w-full h-[85%] rounded-t-2xl pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`) with desktop styles moved under `md:`. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | modal box | Conditional enter animation: `slide-in-from-bottom-full` on mobile, `zoom-in-95` on desktop. Added `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Create (in-file) | grab handle | Mobile-only drag handle (`flex md:hidden`) bound to `onHandlePointerDown`. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | body | Added `min-h-0 overscroll-contain` for reliable flex scrolling / no scroll chaining on mobile. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | `data` | Added `isMobileViewport`, `dragging`, `dragStartY`, `dragOffset`. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | `computed` | Added `isMobile` (uses `$ui.isMobile` with matchMedia fallback) and `dragStyle`. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | `created` | MatchMedia listener resolved before first render. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | `mounted`/`beforeUnmount` | Register/cleanup window `pointermove`/`pointerup` and matchMedia listeners. | | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Modify | `methods` | Added `onHandlePointerDown`, `onPointerMove`, `onPointerUp` (drag-to-dismiss at >110px). | ```vue src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue` | Modify | `` usage | `class="w-5/6 h-5/6"` → `class="md:w-5/6 md:h-5/6"` so the base `h-5/6` no longer fights the sheet's `h-[85%]` on mobile; desktop sizing is unchanged. | | `src/components/chat/ChatInputToolbar.vue` | Modify | `` comment | Documented why sizing is scoped to `md:` (Modal now owns the mobile layout). | --- ### Result | | Before (mobile) | After (mobile) | |---|---|---| | Position | Centered | **Bottom-anchored** | | Width | `100% − 32px` (container `p-4`) | **100%** (full width) | | Height | ~83% (`h-5/6`) | **85%** | | Corners | `rounded-lg` (all) | **`rounded-t-2xl`** (top only) | | Entry | zoom-in | **slide up from bottom** | | Dismiss | ✕ / backdrop / Esc | ✕ / backdrop / Esc **+ drag-down handle** | **Accessibility notes:** the sheet is `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`; the grab handle is decorative (`aria-hidden`), so keyboard users still have the `✕` button (labelled) and `Esc`. Drag-to-dismiss is a progressive enhancement only. **Verification checklist** - [ ] Mobile: sheet is full width, bottom-anchored, slides up, drag handle dismisses (>110px). - [ ] Tapping folders keeps the file browser open (drag handle doesn't interfere with row taps). - [ ] Desktop (`≥768px`): modal still centered, `max-w-2xl`, `h-5/6`, `rounded-lg`, zoom entry — unchanged. - [ ] `Esc`, backdrop tap, and `✕` all still close; modal is not closable via drag when `close` is `false`.

Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Review of the current `Modal.vue` vs. my earlier proposal** The live file has evolved since my last message — it now includes a **`size` prop + `sizeClass` computed** that my proposed version didn't account for. I must preserve that feature. | Aspect | Current file (actual) | My earlier proposal | Resolution | |---|---|---|---| | `size` prop / `sizeClass` | ✅ Present, used in `:class` array | ❌ Missing | **Keep** — merge into new array form | | Root container | `flex items-center justify-center p-4` | `items-end p-0 md:…` | Apply mobile change | | Modal box sizing | base `max-h-[90vh]`, `md:w-auto` | mobile sheet + `md:` | Apply, keep `sizeClass` (already `md:`-scoped) | | Enter animation | `animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95` | conditional mobile/desktop | Apply conditional | | Grab handle + drag | ❌ absent | ✅ | Add | | `role`/`aria-modal` | ❌ absent | ✅ | Add | | Body scroll | no `min-h-0 overscroll-contain` | added | Add | **Key insight:** `sizeClass` values are already `md:`-prefixed (`md:max-w-md`, `md:max-w-2xl`, …), so they **don't interfere with the mobile sheet** — they can stay exactly as-is in the `:class` array.
